description: Fork of blinds/collapse: rects fall flush toward the centre and seal every lane gap, panels coloured from cusphanger tiers on tinted paper
notable: Each block takes one harmony hue, either its contrast tiers (ink, accent, wash) or a window of its cusp ramp; rendered in Display P3

description: One Warnsdorff walk fills the grid as a single line, graded through one cusphanger contrast tier along a short analogous arc of hues
notable: Hues taken off the ring in sequence (shuffle off), so the line travels the arc of the wheel as it travels the grid; unvisited nodes become a wash-tier watermark

description: Rounded arc-tile shapes slide one into the next on a cusphanger tinted ground, ink picked by WCAG contrast tier
notable: Ink modes walk the harmony's hues or the base hue's tiers, so a slide can also be a colour change on the one fixed ground

description: Compass-notebook network: bowed arcs join existing nodes and subdivide into new ones, marked with hollow circles and arrowheads
notable: Endpoints are biased toward busy nodes, collecting arcs into radiating hubs; areas are map-coloured so no touching lunes share a cusphanger hue family

description: Packed pegs wrapped by one rubber band drawn as true offset curves; pegs and band sit on different cusphanger contrast tiers
notable: No bevel: the contrast distance of the tiers from the ground carries the depth; arcs and tangents are separate strokes so self-crossings layer cleanly

description: Terminal-desktop explorer for the cusphanger colour system: parameters, contrast-tier table, hue ring, chroma-lightness slice, specimen, code
notable: Chrome stays black and white so the palette is judged on its own ground; the slice hatches the P3 reach beyond the sRGB shell

description: One differential-growth curve seen through several terminal windows, each a zoomable scope, plus a readout of node count and growth rate
notable: Deeper scopes are drawn as labelled boxes inside shallower ones, so windows visibly look at the same organism

description: Terminal-desktop browser over every src/colors system: systems, library strips, swatch readouts, derived theme and copyable code
notable: The desktop is the specimen: picking a palette retints every window, the bar and the popup through it

description: Trochoidal wave bands in fixed pink and navy, downscaled and Atkinson-dithered; gamepad nudges frequency and amplitude
notable: Variant of trochoidal-wave/dither with a hard-coded three-colour palette; the Albers/mindful picks are commented out
